scope: single A5 TP2 HCCL/fused-RMSNorm micro-path experiment; not a vLLM/FlashComm model or service

health_condition.provenance: pre-existing device warning reported by the external resource audit
health_condition.limit: Results describe this run only; warning impact was not isolated and no healthy-machine performance claim is made

configuration.order: even pair AB; odd pair BA

association.matching: same job, case, mode, explicit iteration and input variant; collective signatures cross-checked
association.device_mapping: exact local torch_to_npu flow endpoints; local connection expansion explicitly labelled
association.context: all exported device tracks intersecting the flow-attributed device window; unlinked context remains unassigned
association.clock: one origin per rank/configuration, shared by its tracks; identical microsecond scale across panels

measurement_limits: Timing samples were collected without profiler; selected traces are separate instrumented iterations.
Host timings include local completion synchronization; NPU events include dependencies and host/peer gaps.
HCCL parents overlap transport and synchronization events; do not add all lane durations.
Communication analysis categories and raw count do not establish measured wire traffic.
RMSNorm row count halves, but B restores full rows with AllGather; this is not full-model FlashComm.
One run and the known device warning limit generalization; no service or healthy-hardware speedup conclusion.
